name: Hypertile
author: Jim Martin
description: Design zone layouts on your screen and let your windows follow. Split and resize zones over your live desktop, cycle layouts with SUPER+L, and send windows to numbered slots by keyboard or drag. Save app arrangements as scenes, arrange your monitors, and restore your desktop after login, all from one overlay, with a bar widget showing the current layout.

barWidget.description: Layout on this monitor's workspace; click for the overlay, scroll or middle-click cycles
